question: Where is the wind-filling air said to be situated in relation to all beings?
premises: There is an air described as wind-filling.
That air is said to be situated in all beings.
The description locates it pervasively rather than in a single place.
inference: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
uncertainties: The mode of its situation is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
